title: Actual-bit rate-distortion for quantized periodic Mirror codes
hypothesis: Quantized/entropy-coded functional codes preserve held-out signal quality at fewer actual bytes than independent sampled curves; Mirror-specific value must beat native quantized activation modulation.
controls: native COIN++-style quantized modulation same code and decoder
storage: Actual serialized byte stream includes version/schema, ranges, bit widths, task indices, quantized values and entropy-coded payload; no parameter-count proxy.
compute: Report support search, bit packing, entropy encode/decode, signal reconstruction arithmetic and wall time.
success_gate: Both seeds: at least one frozen bit width achieves audit nRMSE <=1e-3 and <=25% bytes of independent 8-bit curves; Mirror-specific success also requires strictly better bytes/quality/compute than native modulation.
failure_gate: No rate-distortion point meets quality/storage or exact native alias. Fresh sealed after any failure.
